WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.segment,
        SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM public.yearmonth ym

      AND SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.segment, SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4)

    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2012,

WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, c.district_id, d.a11 AS avg_salary, disp.account_id
    FROM public.client c
    JOIN public.district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN public.disp disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
min_avg_salary AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_salary) AS min_salary FROM female_clients
),
oldest_with_min_salary AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM female_clients fc
    CROSS JOIN min_avg_salary ms
    WHERE fc.avg_salary = ms.min_salary
    ORDER BY fc.birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT account_id FROM oldest_with_min_salary
